description:
Family team building Vowelstream, an Earth Jukebox: move a pointer over NASA Earth visualizations and hear the data. Move to explore, stop to listen.

I’m Dmytro: I think in functions; since middle school I’ve built complex Desmos visualizations. I turn math into sound and images: DSP, formant/modal synthesis (NumPy, C++), OpenCV, Python, NN, JS, ESP32.

Built a node-graph audio/image tool, an autonomous OpenCV robot that finds and pushes targets, and an Arduino fingerprint lock.
